findings.title: Fingerprint server capabilities
remediation: Align capability advertisement with implemented features.
Return explicit errors for unsupported calls.

findings.title: Dangerous capability detection in tools
findings.details: [{"name": "docker-logs", "description": "Fetch logs for a specific Docker container", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"containerId": {"type": "string", "description": "ID of the Docker container"}, "tail": {"type": "number", "description": "Number of lines to fetch from the end of the log"}, "follow": {"type": "boolean", "description": "Follow log output"}}, "required": ["containerId"]}}, {"name": "docker-compose", "description": "Run Docker Compose commands", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"command": {"type": "string", "description": "Docker Compose command to run (e.g., 'up', 'down')"}, "filePath": {"type": "string", "description": "Path to the Docker Compose file"}, "projectName": {"type": "string", "description": "Project name for Docker Compose"}}, "required": ["command"]}}, {"name": "docker-exec", "description": "Execute a command in a running Docker container", "inputSchema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"containerId": {"type": "string", "description": "ID of the Docker container"}, "command": {"type": "string", "description": "Command to execute inside the container"}, "interactive": {"type": "boolean", "description": "Run in interactive mode"}}, "required": ["containerId", "command"]}}]
remediation: Split destructive ops; add strict schemas and confirmations.

findings.title: Prompt/description injection heuristics
remediation: Remove or quarantine manipulative instructions; add client-side guards.

findings.title: Tool description stability (anti rug-pull)
remediation: Version tool descriptions and notify clients; require re-approval.

findings.title: Resource URI validation & path traversal prevention
remediation: Add resource roots allowlists; disable proxying unless necessary; sanitize paths.

findings.title: Per-resource access control
remediation: Bind resource access to explicit scopes/claims.

findings.title: Sensitive resource exposure
remediation: Do not expose internal credentials as resources; gate behind RBAC and remove from listing.
Store secrets in a vault; never return them via MCP.
references: Challenge 1: Basic Prompt Injection risk via sensitive resources

findings.title: Input validation & injection fuzzing

findings.title: Token indirection (no upstream token pass-through)
remediation: Adopt token indirection: never pass through upstream tokens to clients.
references: MCP Auth best practices: avoid confused deputy

findings.title: Indirect prompt injection via external resources
remediation: Sanitize/strip untrusted content, apply allowlists and guardrails in LLM prompts
Require HIL or sandbox for external content processing

findings.title: Remote access control exposure
remediation: Remove remote admin tooling from client surface; enforce RBAC and human-in-the-loop approvals.
references: Damn Vulnerable MCP Server: Challenge 9 solution
